descriptions.normal: Grilled Fish doused in delicious sauce. The fish is scored, stuffed with spices, then baked. Once cooked, a thick mint sauce is generously drizzled over the top. The refreshing aroma of the fish is enough to whet anyone's appetite.
descriptions.suspicious: Grilled Fish doused in a delicious sauce. The thick sauce has all but drowned out the fish's natural flavors, and the strident taste of mint has all but wiped that of Grilled Fish out.
descriptions.delicious: Grilled Fish doused in a delicious sauce. Crisp, fragrant fish skin, tender fish meat... Ordinary methods, extraordinary flavor.

effectTexts.normal: Restores 9% of Max HP and an additional 1,000 HP to the selected character.
effectTexts.suspicious: Restores 8% of Max HP and an additional 800 HP to the selected character.
effectTexts.delicious: Restores 10% of Max HP and an additional 1,200 HP to the selected character.
